# Heart Tree Dungeon
the characters have three obvious ways into the tower,
1. they can enter through the front door (area 1), which leads to an old audience chamber. 
2. they can go down to the river and follow a natural tunnel (area 3) that opens up in the tower’s cellar (area 4). 
3. Or characters can climb the tower walls with successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) checks and enter through the exposed upper Zoor (area 5).

Unless otherwise described, the tower has ceilings 15 feet high and is currently lit by the beam of violet light that passes through it, which fills all areas with bright light.

## 1. FRONT DOOR

Area Aspects. Large stone door, sinister carvings of mages, grinning gargoyle

A large stone door marks the tower’s main entrance. The sinister visages of hooded mages stare out with hollow eyes from each of the doors. A gargoyle statue perched atop the doorframe leers down from above.

the door can be pushed open with a successful DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. Characters can work together to push open the door, granting advantage to the check of the character with the highest Strength score.

CREATURE

the devilish-looking gargoyle above the door was once bound to the service of the Magocracy of the Black Star. Its service ended when the Order of the White Sun took over the tower, but the creature remains magically bound to its perch. It scrutinizes the characters as they deal with the door, swiveling its head around to watch them, and responding in a deep voice if spoken to.

the gargoyle cannot attack unless attacked Xrst. In that event, it makes one attack with its claws, then returns to its perch, lamenting that it is no longer under orders to kill intruders. If addressed with respect, the gargoyle might give up one of the secrets and clues of the tower, described earlier.

## 2. AUDIENCE CHAMBER

### **Area Aspects**
Large ornate throne, statues of unknown heroes, mosaics of a "elves", holes in the ceiling and Zoor, beam of violet light

The corpses of three adventurers lie on the Foor here, all withered and pale. A large ornate throne sits atop a raised platform on the north side of this chamber. Statues of unknown heroes stand at attention, Fanking each other in two rows leading up to the throne. Rotting plaster on the walls is peeling away to reveal old mosaics once covered over.

### **Exits**
- Stairs to the northwest lead down,
- while stairs to the northeast lead up. 
- The Foor and ceiling here have collapsed in the southeast corner, exposing the Foors above and below. A circular hole cut into the center of the Foor matches one in the ceiling.

- If the characters have not yet repaired the altar in area 4, add the following:
	- A pillar of wavering violet light rises between the two holes.

- The old mosaics depict elves, feys, archfeys and star elves (celestials), star elves are placed in the heavens, feys and weird looking elves are placed in the feywild and elves are placed in non-magical forest. From the star elves descends or ascends a beam of light at the end of it, in the middle of the feywild and the non-magical forest, is the symbol of a heart. 

- the statues are more recent, and depict heroes of the feywild, unknown to any from the mundane world. 

### CREATURES

the corpses are three members of the Bronze Lion adventuring party, all withered by necrotic damage. the Bronze Lion adventurers made the mistake of attacking the specter Sarvin here and were overcome. See area 6 for more information on Sarvin.)

Two of the corpses rise as zombies and attack as soon as any character comes more than 10 feet into the room. their eyes glow with a violet light—the same

color as the beam of light in the tower. A character who succeeds on a DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check can determine that the zombies have been created by the power of the beam.

If time is running short or the characters have already faced enough battles, you can skip this encounter.

VIOLET LIGHT

If the altar in area 4 is active, the corrupt energy of the beam of violet light is a hazard to those in this area. Any creature that enters the area of the light for the Xrst time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 3 (1d6) force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from the light.

TREASURE

By searching the bodies, the characters can Xnd 18 gp in mixed coin and a jeweled necklace shaped like a beetle (20 gp), along with standard adventuring gear and nonmagical weapons and armor.

On the body that did not rise as a zombie, the characters Xnd a wand of mending intended to help repair the tower. this uncommon magic item has 7 charges. While holding it, a creature can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the mending cantrip. the wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If a creature expends the wand’s last charge, they roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ash and is destroyed.

3. TUNNEL

Characters who explore the river’s course through the canyon near the tower discover a subterranean side tunnel leading oY the canyon and toward the tower.

Area Aspects. Natural circular tunnel, corrupted water, Grendleroot pillars

A long natural tunnel leads from the rough stone wall of the river to a broken wall of worked stone. A small stream that feeds the river emerges from under the broken wall, but its water has been turned a dirty gray from the presence of a dark liquid dripping out through cracks in the wall. In some areas, the rock walls of the tunnel have eroded away, revealing strange black pillars made of some unknown metal.

the tunnel is roughly 50 feet long and 5 feet in diameter. the black pillars are spires of the Grendleroot that were thrust up from below but did not push above the ground. Like all the Grendleroot spires, they are slightly warm to the touch and completely impervious to damage. The spires are smooth and have no markings on them.

Any character who succeeds on a DC 12 Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check can determine that the water Zowing down the tunnel is corrupted by the essence of the Grendleroot. It is cold to the touch, and anyone who drinks the water takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned for 1 hour.

The broken stone wall at the end of the tunnel is one of the walls of the cellar beneath the tower. Characters can easily slip through gaps in the wall and into the cellar.

CREATURES

When the First character moves roughly halfway down the tunnel, three giant rats crawl out from cleWs in the walls, one in front of the characters and two behind. The rats’ eyes glow with a strange violet light, and they attack any creature that tries to reach the tower. A character who succeeds on a DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check can see that the rats are somehow infused with the power of the violet light.

If time is running short or the characters have already faced enough battles, you can skip this encounter.

4. CELLAR ALTAR

Area Aspects. Broken statue, cracked stone altar, black liquid, spire of the Grendleroot, collapsed stonework, hole in the ceiling, beam of violet light

A cracked stone altar carved with religious iconography stands before a ruined statue of the goddess of light. Ee statue’s head has been broken oI, and black liquid Fows from cracks in its body onto the Foor. Ee liquid pools around a large black spire that juts out of the Foor in the center of the chamber, reaching upward like a great claw.

Stairs to the northeast lead up. Collapsed stone from the Foor and walls of the level above spreads in the southeast corner of the chamber.

A beam of violet light shoots up from the spire, focused through a hole in the ceiling into the tower above.

The spire of the Grendleroot is the source of the corruption in the tower. Fed by the black blood Zowing from the corrupted statue on the altar, the spire uses its energy to attempt to communicate with

IN THE CELLAR ALTAR

an otherworldly being, channeling the thoughts of the Grendleroot through the crystal on the tower’s uppermost Zoor (area 6) and the larger crystal hanging in the ceiling in the cavern above.

CREATURE

Allice Shadewhisperer, a chaotic neutral human female cult fanatic, lies prone on the Zoor here, her arms outstretched toward the spire. She stands when the characters enter, demanding to know whether they too have come in response to the call of the spire. Any character who observes her notes that black ichor appears to be Zowing from her eyes.

Allice was one of the Bronze Lions adventurers who came to the tower. Her comrades all fell to the specter Sarvin, and only she remains. Having been corrupted over the three days since she came here, she now spends all her time whispering to the spire and eating rats to survive.

Allice can be convinced that her worship of the spire is folly with a successful DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check. The spire’s corruption has broken her mind, but she is not evil. She defends the spire if she feels that the characters are disrupting its connection to her.

In combat, Allice uses spiritual weapon to call a spectral black sword that attacks one enemy, while she casts sacred Fame on others. Her sacred Fame cantrip evokes black Xre that deals necrotic damage instead of radiant damage.

Allice might have become weakened over the time she’s spent in the cellar of the tower. You can adjust her hit point total based on her physical state if you want to adjust the pace and diUculty of combat.

If you wish to make the encounter harder (while remembering that 1st-level characters are particularly vulnerable), Allice might be protected by one or two zombies risen from her former comrades. The undead Xght at her side, but automatically fall when she is defeated. You likely only want to do this if the characters are higher than 1st level, or if there are more than Xve characters in the party.

VIOLET LIGHT

While the altar is active, see area 2 for information on the hazardous eYects of the beam of violet light.

CALL OF THE GRENDLEROOT

The spire of the Grendleroot resonates with a strange buzzing sound as the beam of violet light blazes up through the tower. A character can attempt a DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) check to investigate the spire. On a success, a character becomes conscious of the call of the Grendleroot as it is transmitted

through the tower. They know that some form of intelligence is attempting to call out to another entity. You can Xll in the details with as much information as you wish, customized for your own campaign. See “What is the Grendleroot?” in the “About this Book” chapter for more information.

If a character fails this check, they suYer a random form of short-term madness for 10 minutes as their mind buckles under the weight of the Grendleroot’s call. Appendix B has more information on short-term madness.

REPAIRING THE ALTAR

The statue and the altar can be repaired with three uses each of the mending cantrip. The altar can also be repaired with a successful DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) check.

If the statue and the altar are both repaired, the corrupting power of the Grendleroot spire is broken and the black liquid stops Zowing. The room Xlls with a white radiant light that Zows up through the ceiling to the crystal on the roof of the tower. Though the black spire remains in the chamber, its dark power fades when the altar is repaired. Unless the characters have repaired the crystal in area 6, however, the tower’s corruption is not ended, and they recognize that more work needs to be done above.

TREASURE

Set atop the altar are a golden bowl and plate (25 gp each) and a small idol of the goddess of light (50 gp).

5. UPPER SUITES

Area Aspects. Crumbling walls, ruined chambers, collapsed Zoor, outset walls, holes in the ceiling and Zoor, beam of violet light

Time has not been kind to the tower’s second Foor. Collapsed walls reveal ruined bedchambers and storage rooms. A cracked stone staircase in the northwest extends to the Foor above. Ee southeast corner of the Foor and ceiling have both collapsed, exposing the Foor above and below. A circular hole cut into the center of the Foor matches one in the ceiling.

If the characters have not yet repaired the altar in area 4, add the following:

A pillar of wavering violet light rises between the two holes.

VIOLET LIGHT

If the altar in area 4 is active, see area 2 for information on the hazardous eYects of the beam of violet light.

SECRET SHRINE

The far corner of the mostly intact bedchamber to the southwest features two outset stone walls with no visible openings. A character who succeeds on a DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check discovers a hidden lever at the foot of the east wall that slides a section of that wall open, revealing a small shrine beyond. The shrine features a bronze statue of a seated knight with arms extended and palms up. A gold-hilted longsword rests across the knight’s hands (see “Treasure” below).

CREATURES

If you wish to include a combat encounter here, three skeletons wearing the livery of the Order of the White Sun rise from the rubble and attack.

TREASURE

The sword set across the statue’s hands is a +1 longsword named Goldkiss. This is an uncommon magic item whose design features the sword-andblazing-sun symbol of the Order of the White Sun. A character attuned to the weapon can use an action to cast a version of the burning hands spell that deals radiant damage instead of Fire damage. This feature of the weapon can’t be used again until the next dawn.

6. ROOFTOP

Area Aspects. Huge crystal, collapsed Zoor, broken walls, beam of violet light

Ee walls and ceiling of the upper level of the tower have collapsed, leaving this area exposed to the cavern beyond. A two-foot-diameter crystal sits atop a large pedestal of twisted green-and-gold metal at the center of the Foor. Ee southeast corner of the Foor has collapsed to reveal the levels below.

If the characters have not yet repaired the altar in area 4, add the following:

Swirling violet energy Fows around the base of the pedestal. A crack in the crystal emits a beam of wavering violet light that shoots upward to a much larger crystal set into the ceiling of the cavern, one hundred feet above.

THE BEACON OF STARSONG TOWER

VIOLET LIGHT

If the altar in area 4 is active, see area 2 for information on the hazardous eYects of the beam of violet light.

CALL OF THE GRENDLEROOT

Characters in this area can attempt to listen to the call of the Grendleroot in the same way as described in area 4.

CREATURE

Sarvin Bluecaster, a former priest of the Order of the White Sun transformed into a specter, Zows around the base of the crystal in incorporeal form. When the characters Xrst arrive, he manifests into his original humanoid form to speak with them.

Sarvin is not immediately hostile. The priest is tortured by the corruption of the crystal, and yet remains bound to protect it. The characters can convince Sarvin of their intent to restore the tower and end the corruption with a successful DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check. On a failed check, Sarvin attacks.

As an action, Sarvin uses Life Drain against three diYerent targets, but each attack deals 3 (1d6) necrotic damage instead of its normal damage. He moves between attacks, provoking opportunity attacks to hit multiple targets instead of just one.

REPAIRING THE CRYSTAL

If Sarvin is defeated or convinced to let them work, the characters can undo the corruption of the crystal with three castings of the mending cantrip, or with a successful DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) check. If this check fails by 5 or more, a bolt of violet energy arcs out to deal 3 (1d6) necrotic damage to the character attempting the check.

The characters can attempt to repair the crystal while battling Sarvin. If they are successful, the specter’s madness ends when the crystal is repaired, and he ends his hostility as his pain leaves him.

When the crystal is repaired, the violet light no longer Zows to the larger crystal in the cavern ceiling.

If the altar in area 4 is likewise repaired, the crystal instead releases a beam of radiant energy to the crystal above, restoring the tower’s original function and Xlling the cavern with light to reZect the state of night and day in the world above.

Concluding the Adventure

When the adventure ends, the characters have hopefully restored the radiant light of the tower. This light shines down from the cavern’s ceiling above Deepdelver’s Enclave, creating a simulated day and night cycle for the enclave’s inhabitants. The characters reach 2nd level, and the people of Deepdelver’s Enclave thank them enthusiastically for their eYorts, marking them as valued residents of the enclave.

With the corruption of the altar ended, Starsong Tower is no longer a dangerous site to explore. In recognition of their role in cleansing the site, the characters are given permission to restore the tower as a home base for their adventures to come.

If the characters managed to convince either Allice or Sarvin to let go of their connection to the Grendleroot spire, either of them might choose to remain in the tower. Allice could decide to give up adventuring with her friends now gone, oYering to be the caretaker of the tower while the characters are oY exploring. Sarvin might remain as a friendly guardian or spiritual guide, and can provide information on the Order of the White Sun.

Depending on your plans for the campaign, the characters can continue with further investigations of the mysteries contained deep within the mountain, as they explore the ruins of the Grendleroot.

# Skovens Hjerte
I skal rejse ind i den sydlige skov, Blackwood, og hjælpe dets beboere med at rense noget korruption.

## Portalen Til Feywild
I har fulgt anvisninger og fandt en bestemt gammelt træ i skoven, bag det fandt i en slags døråbning formet af træer der er filtreret sammen. Åbningen fører ind i en lille lund hvor der står en monolit omgivet af mindre sten i en cirkel på jorden.

I blev bedt om at medbringe nogle specielle ting, en flaske med noget klart væske, en lille æske med et stykke glødende kul og en lille rund og vel poleret sten. 

Disse placerede i på bestemte steder på monolitten, mens i hver især aktiverede en rune med en dråbe af jeres blod.

## Feywild Trek
På den anden side af portalen, har i rejst i noget tid, det er svært for jer at vurdere tiden da solen aldrig går ned i Feywild. Men i har slået lejr 1 gang.

Luften er mættet med fortryllelse og farverne er mere intense og levende end i er vant til. Nogle træer har perlemor skær og smaragd funklende blade. Enhver tænkelig farve er at finde i naturen her og jeres næse frydes af masser af kraftige blomster dufte.

Der hvor i kom ud stod en satyr og ventede på jer, den introducerede sig som Cailach, jeres guide.

På jeres tur igennem denne magiske skov verden, oplevede i: 

- en lund af syngende blomster der nynnede melodier som reflekterede jeres følelser. 

- svævende sten hen over en sø, nede i søens krystal klare vand var der lysende fisk. 

- på den anden side hører i et jagt horn og Cailach advarer jer om den vilde jagt som i for alt i verdenen skal undgå. 

- en sti igennem et kraftigt torne krat, som bevægede sig og gjorde det besværligt at komme igennem.

## Hjerte Træet
Endelig ankom i til en kæmpe lund, i midten rager et gigantisk træ op i himlen. Dets krone er mørk og gløder mørk lilla, luften i lunden er tyk med en sygelig sød duft af råd og fordærv. Jorden er fyldt med rester af frodig natur, visne og sorte. Skyggerne fra træets krone ser ud til at bevæge sig på unnaturlige måder, nærmest med deres egen vilje. 

Ud af træet, et stykke oppe, skyder nærmest en stråle af pink/lilla energi ind i skoven mod et ukendt sted.

Der hænger en tæt tåge hen over jorden, lige i hovede højde. 

Cailach siger at hun ikke kan gå længere, luften i denne lund og den korrupterende aura fra træet vil gøre hende ondt og til sidst vil hun ende som de vandrende og hun peger på en skikkelse der går rundt længere inde i lunden. 

"Inde i midten er træet, I kan enten bruge døren eller klatre op og kravle ind af et vindue eller tage en lille tunnel fra en nærliggende bæk der går ind under træet. Den lys stråle i kan se deroppe, den er igang med at nedbryde seglet der holder Feydark monsterne væk. Hvis det segl brydes vil Fomorian kongens horde vælte ind i vores land."

"Vi ved ikke hvad der foregår inde i træet, men vi ved at skovens hjerte er fanget derinde og er på en eller anden måde kilden til korruptionen og lys strålen."

handout-blue-dragonscale-mail-recipe.md:
Main: Master loot Related: Dragon Scale Mail
### Blue Dragon Scale Mail

_Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement)_

Blue Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of atleast 50 year old dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued.

While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and Lightning breath weapons of blue dragons, and you have resistance to Lightning.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest dragon within 30 miles of you that is of the same type as the armor. This special action can’t be used again until the next dawn.

|**Save advantage**|**Resistance**|
|--------------------------|-------------------|
|Dragons frightful presence|Lighting|
|Breath weapons of dragons|-|

---

**Materials**: One intact scale from an [blue dragon](app://obsidian.md/blue%20dragon), [premium leather](app://obsidian.md/premium%20leather), [web silk from a Drider](app://obsidian.md/web%20silk%20from%20a%20Drider), [Atigax fungus](app://obsidian.md/Atigax%20fungus), [blood of a Storm or Cloud Giant](app://obsidian.md/blood%20of%20a%20Storm%20or%20Cloud%20Giant).

**Instructions**: Dry the Atigax mushrooms for one week. Treat the web with an alchemical concoction of ground Atigax and Giant’s blood for up to four weeks. Assemble your leather and scale with the treated web thread.

**Proficiencies**: [Leatherworker’s Tools](app://obsidian.md/Leatherworker%E2%80%99s%20Tools), [Alchemist’s Tools](app://obsidian.md/Alchemist%E2%80%99s%20Tools)  
**Cost**: 20,000 gp  (Total cost, travel, hirelings, tools, materials etc)
**Workweeks**: 25

jagos-letter-to-frekka.title: Jagos letter to Frekka
jagos-letter-to-frekka.md:
Dear Frekka, 

I hope this note finds you well. Though we have not spoken much, I have admired the strength and grace you carry yourself with through our town. It is rare to meet someone who stands out so vividly amidst the ordinary.

In my craft, I find meaning in creating small yet lasting pieces that carry a story. The enclosed necklace is no exception. I designed it with you in mind, drawing inspiration from the fleeting beauty of wildflowers. I hope it serves as a token of appreciation for the light you bring to those around you—even from afar.

Please accept these small gifts as a gesture of admiration and respect.

Yours sincerely,
Jago Coitor

prior-thorne-journal-excerpts.title: Prior Thorne journal excerpts
prior-thorne-journal-excerpts.md:
Latest entry

..finally i have the location. I know which church building the references are about, it is time to exploit my relationship with Father Pelgraine. I must get situated in the building…

...Father Thorne is a good choice, he is close to Father Pelgraine, who is greatly situated to get me into the monastery.

...Father Pelgraine is most accepting to my advances, it was almost like he knew i wanted something from him. The influence he has on the Abbott is great, this has to work. I must get to it, it haunts my dreams and beckons my waken hours. The whispers of unlimited knowledge, the secrets of the gods!..

..I am finally here! i can feel it, it is here somewhere. I am having some difficulty finding the entrance, but i shall succeed…

..Finally, i got the emeralds, the work can begin. But I need to send Tomas away, he is the only one that knows i have found the catacombs so far. Perhaps a run to Teslions to search for papers from the construction of the monastery...

Earlier entries in the journal

In my search for a solution, i came across something in Kavakariad’s Eldritch Knowledge, called the whisper skulls. They yield power over the dead, with this power I could get some answers about the sapphiretail.

Prior Thorne has been searching for various sources of power over the years, his journal shows a great lust for knowledge of power and little in terms of inhabitions. This was the reason he got into an occult society in Kvalec, it was in this society he found some old documents and read about the Sapphiretail staff.

All other objects of desire seem to fade away once he learned the name of sapphiretail, all his entries after is about his quest to find it. He has scoured libraries, use lots of his merchant fortunes to pay bards for their knowledge, he has sought and bought all manner of books, scrolls and objects from anyone. Nothing mundane gave him any knowledge.

At some point he seems to have made a pact with some otherworldly entity he calls Atlach-Nacha, who promised to give him more knowledge. Through his pact he learned of an ancient creation from Tashrans Glory days, the whispers skull and their supposed power of the dead. His notes surmise that if he can gain the power to question the dead, maybe he can find the Tomb of Durso Preiss and ask him where the staff was last seen.

He has been following clues and leads about the whisper skulls and learned one was locked away in an ancient catacomb from an even older empire than Tashran. A secret demon worshipping cult of Orcus had learned of the catacomb, underneath an unknowing monastery and infiltrated the monk order and began doing their secret cult things in the catacombs. Eventually they were discovered and eradicated by The silent sisters. The journal does not go into who they are. He does not mention any dates or years, but it seems to be a long time ago, obscure knowledge people would have forgotten today.

Good news your highness! We carried out a test yesterday. As you predicted, consuming fresh elf caused a newly hatched dragonfiend to grow to full size very rapidly. In a day or two, the rest of the eggs should be ready to hatch. Regilarix [the black dragon] will command the surrounding lizardfolk and lead them to battle. Once the elf settlement has been fed to the hatchlings we should be just a few days away from joining the horde at the walls of Arendur.

Your faithful servant, Saarvith.

secret-transport-report-saarvith.title: Secret transport - Report - Saarvith
secret-transport-report-saarvith.md:
Great Warmaster, 

I present to you here with this shipment, 2 examples of your secret weapon. The “**Razorfiends**”. **Regilarix** has been in dominating Basharix, we have managed to procure 3 clutches in total from both. Getting Ozziandrix on our side was fortunate.

We have successfully taken over contact with the smugglers after Ratbag’s demise. The sky iron will now flow through Blackspear instead of the Citadel. We have enlisted the Lizardmen who have flocked to the swamp to worship **Regilarix** to transporting in the swamp. We have sent the first shipment of sky iron items to **Glitterhame**, I got word that our allies there finally worked out the secret of working the **forge of fury**. Our warlocks have begun work on a portal, so we can get both the Razorfiends and the fury weapons to the horde. 

**The Daughters of Meg** takes less and less interest in our work, they seem to be working on projects of their own. One of those i learned had to do with Bedegaarn Keep, they sent Sunkiller there on business. At least they are not as meddling anymore. I wonder if **Ripper** and **Stormshadow** are done with them? 

We are still escorting packs of Stormshadows prisoners to the Aunties, these **Ogre Plant monsters** are even bigger and stronger than the first ones. Remind me not to be caught as a criminal in Takarnn! 

The swamp is growing still, Regilarix enjoys it and any potential wanderers wont be stumbling upon us easily. I have let loose a few Razorfiends to take care of any nosy adventurers wandering too close to the Castle. We shall not share the fate of Ratbag. 

We have taken in a **nearby goblin tribe** to act as eyes and ears in the blackwood, they are VERY good spies. The nearby elves keep out of the swamp, Regilarix is constantly arguing for razing their city. Mostly i think it’s because she found out they have one of **the lost staves of Illnor**. But unless they cause any trouble i dont want to waste resources on them and their giant owls.

Our scouts have returned from the sunken citadel, the Oztters have cleaned up and the corruption we started there has taken root. The daughters said that the heart of the forest is infected and once it is entirely consumed by the corruption, the blackwood will live up to its name. They seem very happy about it, I don’t see how that helps our war, maybe it makes it easier for our allies in the Feywild to get through? I would ask the Daughters, but i really don’t like them or being around them for too long. I am sure they are plotting to cook and eat me, maybe my dragon keeps them in check or maybe they are just pre-occupied with something else. I mean why are they sending minions to Mercadia? 

I shall send word on the sending stone when we are ready to open the portal.

Warchief Saarvith

the-cautier-intelligence-report-bedegaar.title: The Cautier Intelligence report - Bedegaar barony
the-cautier-intelligence-report-bedegaar.md:
# [The Cautier School](#note/the-cautier-school)
The Cautier School is an intelligence gathering organization working on behalf of the throne of Arendur. 
They operate all over Ursia. 
You are already familiar with the leader of the region [Lord Davide Castilla](#note/lord-davide-castilla) 

%%
Underground Syndicate - Spy network 
cautier: 
%%

# The Clock
A thieves guild based in Bedegaarn city that is no friend to the new Regent Hexton. 
If you get yourselves into a war, they have a crew of ruffians, specialists and rogues ready to throw down. 

%% However their Leader Zola has been captured by Regent Hexton and will soon hang. If you were to rescue her from the hangman, the Clock would most likely be friendly to a request for aid. (lending a special unit to warfare) 
Underground Syndicate - Thieves guild
%%

%%

%%
# The Star Chamber - The black lilly order
The home of the Black lilly order, Regent Hexton's knight order in Bedegaarn. 
If Hexton or the Knight order has any secrets, this must be where they keep them.
Maybe if you can get inside, you could uncover some secrets or take out one or more lieutenants?
- The starchamber is also their temple, sanctuary and mystic source of power. 
- They closely guard the rituals they conduct. 
- Very few outsiders are allowed inside the building.
- They frequently purchase supplies for their rituals from a guild of arcanists and herbalists, known for wearing cowled green robes.
- The bedegaarn prison  also periodically brings priosners to the star chamber and they never leave. 
- Since this is their head quarters, there might be important information. Battle plans, alliances or other secrets. 

%%Despotic regime%%

# House of Lord Vermil
The ancient noble manor called Halls of the frost wolf has been in the Holtz family all of recorded history about the place, which is the last 500 years. 

[Lord Vermil](#note/lord-vermil) is the last living descendant of the blood line. 

We don't know much about the noble manor or it's lords and ladies, they seem to have always been in the region and make little fuzz and don't get much involved in the regional politics. 

His alliegiances are also unknown to us at this point. 

%% Noble court - ancient family %% 

# [Ravenscrest Emporium](#note/ravenscrest-emporium)
A trade's empire that has spread all over Ursia has come to the barony. Many wonder why they have not set up shop in Bedegaarn which is a bigger city.

The shop in Delios is part of a larger merchantile network and they appear to be very adept at selling almost anything. 

Generally not much is known about the Emporium, other than they tend to avoid larger cities, which most find odd. 

The head of the emporium is known as Magnus Blackthorn, the head of the local shop is [Alistair Kingsley](#note/alistair-kingsley). 

They recently sponsored a new bathhouse in Delios. 

%% Merchants guild  %%

# Feyfolk Court
%% fey court %%
There are rumours of a fey court inside Blackwood. 

We do not known if they have any alliances or where exactly they are located or even what they call themselves. 

We know there are elves in Blackwood, they are often seen flying over the forest on giant owls.

But ever since the dragon showed up 5 years ago, sightings have been less frequent. 

There is one who visits Delios and other settlements on a winged white owlbear.

- Finding the elves is most likely not the challenge, it is likely they will find you first if you go looking.
- Negotiating with elves might be hard, since the last alliance between elves & men in the region was broken by men centuries ago 
- Fey folks are known to be mercurial of temperament, changing with the seasons. Chaotic in the spring, joyful in the summer, contetmplating and melancholic in the autumn and fatalistic in the winter. Winter is never the time for new beginnings (or alliances) but it can be a time of war.

# White Tusk Orcs
This is a relative new faction, they are normally based in the southern mountain chain, but recently they wandered into the blackwoods where they roam like nomads.

The Orcs value strength. It is important for a white tusk leader to show the clan that either she or the clan gained something of value as part of a negotiation.

The steel knights came across corpses of Orcs mauled by a massive beast. The injuries and tracks would indicate something akin to a giant ape. If you wish to deal with the white tusks, perhaps defeating this beast can buy you goodwill with them. 

- We believe them to be nomadic and in the blackwoods 
- We are not aware of them being in any known alliances 
- defeat the giant ape to gain favor and goodwill 
- alternatively grant the clan a gift of a magic item
- an elite orc unit to fight for us could prove very useful

%% 
npc realm - orc clan 
special unit - the unbreakable 
%% 

# Neighbor Barony (Dalrath)
Lord Kenway of Dalrath is regarded as a just ruler with a large army and the finest cavelry, including a unit of magic hounds! 

Allying with Lord Kenway and having the aid of his magic hounds would be immensely valuable. 
 
However we have nothing to offer the Baron of Dalrath. 
- Bad news is that he is busy with a war on goblins and wild elves
- Good news is that we can send him missives through a [Diplomats pouch](#note/diplomats-pouch) 
- The barony of Dalrath is allied with a different Duke than Bedegaarn Barony, so any overt action from Dalrath against Hexton could cause major incident politically

%%
# The Tower of Mistview
Necromancer Caliga is a reviled by the people of the region because of her foul practices. 
We suspect she might be allied with Regent Hexton. 
We believe she occupies the tower in the center of the now ruined village. 

- A generation ago, before Caliga appeared, the tower of Mistview watched over the small village of mistview. A wizard moved in and expanded the tower and then disappeared. The next word from the village was that all inhabitants were undead and a wicked Necromancer attacked any who went near the tower.
- There is a wild overgrown area around the ruined tower , that could potentially offer cover to approach unseen. 
- so far little else is known 
%%

# The charnel house
Not long ago a group calling themselves the Charnel House settled in the region, 
After they defeated the wizard Zhakius Stormborn they seized his tower as salvage and spoils of war.
A perpetual storm rages around the top of the tower, which sits atop a rocky hilltop. 
The tower once guarded deep catacombs, which no one remembers the origin of.

The Charnel house has a bad reputation, they will just as soon set you on fire as look at you.

Their leader is Irae Firetouched a halfling fire sorcerer 
the other members are known as 
- Kryx Blodgnash, Beast of the dark wood 
- Athlonia the moon's eclipse
- Uldun the silent death 

They are mercenaries and are known to hire local brigands, spies, cult fanatics, murderers and regular mercenaries to bolster their ranks. 

%% npc realm arcadia 6 pg 13 %%

book-of-the-raven.title: book of the raven
book-of-the-raven.md:
### Tale of Vistani Kindness

The _Book of the Raven_ is the firsthand account (written in Common) of an anonymous author who, after falling off her horse and breaking her leg, was rescued and befriended by Vistani travelers who graciously nursed her back to health. The author and her horse traveled with the Vistani for three months, during which the author spent most of her time laid up in a Vistani covered wagon, where she took to writing this book to pass the time. Although a dozen Vistani are colorfully described in the tome, only two are mentioned by name: Drasha, a teenaged girl who applied bandages and poultices to the author's wounded leg, and Darzin, a one-armed boy with a terrible fear of wolves who sang beautiful songs to help the author take her mind off the pain.

The book provides a detailed account of the Vistani way of life, with emphasis on their food and music. Their overland journey is also discussed, albeit from the viewpoint of one who spent most of it inside a covered wagon. The author describes rough roads, days of travel through impenetrable mist and thick forest, crackling fires on cold nights, wolves howling in the dead of night, and ravens pecking at the roof of the wagon in the wee hours of the morning.

Late in the book, the author writes of being able to hobble about on crutches. She describes the cheery mood of her benefactors as the Vistani caravan traveled a winding mountain road to the gates of a tall, dark castle. The book ends with a description of the castle's dreadful countenance. The writing abruptly stops on the third-to-last page, suggesting that the book was snatched from the author in midsentence. The last two pages are blank.

### Vistani Lore

Characters who read the _Book of the Raven_ learn the following information about the Vistani:

- The Vistani are planar travelers often encountered in the Shadowfell, and they seem to be immune to the despair that besets all other visitors to that plane. They travel in horse-drawn, barrel-shaped wagons and have no permanent home.  
- The Vistani display their wealth openly as a sign of prosperity, sharing their good fortune with friends and strangers alike. Vistani resolve disagreements through contests that end with reconciliatory singing, dancing, and storytelling.  
- Vistani families can be big or small, but each family is a gerontocracy, with the oldest member ruling the roost. This elder has most of the responsibility for enforcing traditions, settling disputes, setting the course for the group's travels, and preserving the Vistani way of life.  
- The Vistani have the power—some say gift—to travel through the mists that lead to forlorn realms within the Shadowfell known as the Domains of Dread, where creatures born in darkness dwell. This "gift" was thrust upon them by mysterious entities called the Dark Powers, as a boon for their kindness toward strangers.  
- The Vistani believe that ravens carry lost souls within them. Hence, killing a raven is considered bad luck in Vistani culture.  

In a not so super secret pocket at the back, a map is hidden away.

cutscene-1.title: Cutscene 1
cutscene-1.md:
\*not character knowledge\*

The camera pans down from a darkened cloudy sky, a big dark forest looms in the background and the camera settles upon a warcamp in a mountain valley. Many barbaric banners have been posted around the camp, several depicting various units or clans but many of them fly the symbol of the red hand.

[^1]

Among the many assembled Goblins, trots a huge coal black horse of war with the calm of an eye of a storm. It's hooves, mane and tail are wreathed in purple flames, it's eyes shines with smoldering purple embers. Astride the mount sits dark clothed elven female figure, with the same calm and not even noticing any of the many creatures around her.

Her warhorse trots through the camp until it comes to a halt infront of a wooden construct, a dias and a throne. The camera pans up from the horses hooves, revealing a wooden dias littered with skulls and bones of many different creatures, we come to a halt as we see the foot of the throne and a pair of black plated boots.

A throathy reptillian voice speaks from the throne "Ah, Sunkiller. Should you not be out and about on your errands for those wretched hags? I do not remember any tasks for you yet?". We see the pale elven maid's gaze lift slowly from the dias to the throne, not blinking, unflinching. A sharp piercing voice void of compassion "I am as displeased with my presence here as yourself, i come with news from Bitarra.".

The rolling crackle of a voice answers her "Never displeased Sunkiller, never that. I have the utmost respect for you and your skill. You being here now however, is not according to plan. What news from that watery wench?". Sunkiller answers him with a soft almost childlike voice "Ratbag has fallen, the sunken citadel is lost. Bitarra has seen it for herself through the gift of the hag eye. A band of adventurers out of Arendur, the crimson company. They might even destroy the Gulthias Tree." with a slight undertone of mirth.

"A shame, I had hoped to groom Ratbag into a great general. No matter, we are all but ready to set the HORDE on its march. Ratbag succeeded in gathering enough information. You can inform the hags that Warchief Slythe will be crossing Skull Bridge in about 3 days, I expect them to divert from their little side affairs in order to assist Warchief Saarvith and keep the barrier up on Akacia, whatever it is they are doing on the side for Meg evil eye cannot set back our invasion. Stormshadow was promised full support, i want them to remember that."

Sunkiller does a slight bow, the only movement she has made since entering the camp, as she is making to turn her mount around the man on the throne says in as soft a voice as his reptillian features allow "oh and by the way sun**killer**" the last part of the name emphazised "**your** masters are not the only ones watching, i wonder, what is your interest in that half-elf?" you can almost hear the wicked grin shaping on the last syllables. Sunkillers head snaps up to face the speaker in a flash, red energy crackles from her eyes and red lightning travels down her arm. "Oh ho ho, fear not. I have no reason to betray you to those entropy ridden bitches. That is, unless you give me reason to, you will do well to remember that elf." amusement dripping from every word with a small dose of disturbing laughter in between. Sunkiller seems to realize that she was not in control of her emotions and instantly all energy is extinguished. "Warmaster" she says coldly, her tone inferring he had played his hand well.

Camera fades out as Sunkiller leaves the camp on her coal black steed of war.

[^1]: Red Hand symbol

cutscene-10-deadsquad.title: Cutscene 10 - Deadsquad
cutscene-10-deadsquad.md:
# Deadsquad - Cutscene #10

Jawbreaker materialised in his warcamp, his bodyguard checking the tent at the sound of his arrival. He dismissed them with a wave, but one of them stayed "What is it ?" Jawbreaker impatiently demanded. "The death squad has not checked in, last word was they had set up an ambush. It's been days now." Jawbreaker roared and flipped over a sturdy table with all sorts of papers "That miserable bunch of ... " he could not have this, while discipline held this army together, he did not believe in leadership of entitlement. You had to prove yourself to lead, he needed to show this horde he was still in control. "Warmaster." His train of thought was interrupted "What!" a voice cleared it's throat and one of the spy masters goblins entered the tent "The special transport from Blackspear was supposed to have arrieved, but there is no sign of it yet" the warmaster growled "send word to Saarvith, get a progress report on the circle. Have we uncovered the sigils for the target yet?" the goblin squinted its eyes "we are still working on that warmaster, it is tricky business, well guarded information." Jawbreaker approached the goblin, towered over him "Snikkter better deliver or there will be no rock, no gutter, no cave, no chasm he can hide in that my wrath wont find him, you tell him that."

Jawbreaker sat down again and wondered what foul plans to put into motion to deal with these pesky heroes... "if they are responsible for the transport not getting here, Saarvith, you better not have left anything in that wagon pointing to Blackspear. The last thing i need is for them to keep our lizards from being used."

cutscene-11-game-on.title: Cutscene 11 - Game on
cutscene-11-game-on.md:
# Game on - Cutscene #11

Elsewhere in utter darkness a voice creaks like an old haunted house "The pieces are in motion, opening moves over, now the game begins."

Another voice joins the conversation like a queen calming her children "They might manuever their defences now, but see the prize they are willing to pay. Arrogance, the absolute faith in his power is almost befitting of our cause. I wonder... you know the ruby prison is but one weapon, what if we could turn HIM?"

The first voice responds with a snort "forget it, he is of the black orb, while they are selfcentered enough they still believe in structure and order and laws, if only to keep them in power. They do not believe in the right of might. No, once his obsidian spear is done his strongest player will be in the game. See how they all flock to his meatgrinder, none the wiser. Our preparations are strong, but it will be easier if this plan of his fails, if he does not manifest."

"Perhaps, these rogue agents will get in his way. Mortals often prevail in the face of great adversity after all. Over and over and over again, struggle and strife, such eternal entertainment. Yet even should he claim control and campaign against our cults, he will only delay us, we have shrouded our greatest weapon even from him who so loves to covet what others know. He might think he knows what's coming, but two can play his game of secrets, she will be free once again."

the hoarse croaking replies "You put too much stock in that one i think. I have a backup im working on, if the incursion fails once again. Maybe it's time for a do over.... "

"no... i was just getting fond of that world."

cutscene-2-blackleaf-goblins-escape.title: Cutscene 2 - Blackleaf goblins escape
cutscene-2-blackleaf-goblins-escape.md:
*Sod this! -* he thought to himself as he felt every biting sting of his wounds, one more lucky cut or some nasty dwarf magic and he would be dead and nobody would know the portal would fail. He had a newfound hatred of Dwarves, *hells that hammer hurt!* Scabnose looked at Zarrkle the warlock goblin lying dead on the cavern floor, the skulls of the hangmantree effigy floating in the air and the fomorian giant trying to get through the portal. *Sod this* he thought again. *Bitarri sent Sunkiller to Jawbreaker to report* he had heard her give the order before she ran to her pool, she would sod off to Blackspear castle, leave them here to die.

Scabnose gathered his strength and set his mind to sprinting all he could, there was that narrow almost invisible passage into "the rift". If he could get past the nasty adventurers, he could get out, the crawl vines were not far from the rift. He eyed his moment and ran all he could muster, *sod this, sod them!*

He found the narrow passage and pushed through the rock wall, *Yes!* He ran some more, into the crawl vine room and climbed up to the upperfloor of the citadel. He was immediately challenged by the guards posted at the top and when he told them his story everyone began hustling. The corrupted goblins, with all their mysterious growths, gathered their belongings and began shouting and calling alarms gathering the survivors of the Citadel.

"We go to Skull Bridge boys, get message to Cinder Hill. Sunkiller has left for Jawbreaker, but we can get word to Warchief Slythe. If they follow us, Ozzy will take care of them at the bridge." Scabnose instructed the gathering soldiers, he was all there was left of any kind of commander now. No shamans, no warlocks, no chiefs.. Just him, Slythe would reward him for bringing word for sure.

The twenty some goblins headed for the cracked Citadel wall that opened up near the ancient staircase up to the floor of the blackwoods forest. As they hustled up the staircase Scabnose looked up to check if the adventurers had come down this way and removed their ropes, they hadn't. He looked back over his shoulder towards the small courtyard they had ignored, the exit Moogzt had used when that ambitious bunch of goblins had wanted to press further inland. They must have met the adventurers and they had backtracked the goblins here. *Curse you Moogzt!* *To the nine hells with you!*

The red hand soldiers scrambled up from the crevasse in the blackwoods and disappeared into the undergrowth, headed west towards Skull Bridge. As he ran with his boys Scabnose thought to himself *I will hurt you back Dwarf, i will break your skull and your sodding hammer.* A voice whispered in his mind *Scab, Scabby..* He thought he smelled sulfur for a moment *Scabby, I can help you, lets make a deal* the voice whispered..

cutscene-3-a-crystal-dreams-in-the-mist.title: Cutscene 3 - A Crystal Dreams in the mist
cutscene-3-a-crystal-dreams-in-the-mist.md:
A electric blue mist swirls sluggishly inside a strange room with oddly angled walls, the walls appear smooth like glass and shimmer back and forth between yellow and pink hues. Inside the mist is a dark silhouette, it is humanoid with a big wild mane of hair. The figure walks slowly and purposely out of the mist, which slides off the being revealing a lions face with ruby eyes.

The figure speaks with a deep and smooth voice "Qa'tek! It has begun, the Crystal warrior has been revealed."

From out of one of the walls steps another figure, it looks like a living statue made of pink and purple crystals, it comes to a halt and stands utterly motionless. The figure from the mist approaches the statue and draws forth a ruby the size of a heart, it reaches out to the statues chest and as the ruby comes closer a cavity begins to form in the statue. As the ruby is enclosed inside the statues chest the statue's eyes light up ruby red. The statue begins to take the shape and appearance of a lithe human woman with tar black dreadlocks.

"Qa'tek! Seeker am I, searcher am I, finder of the Crystal Warrior will i be." The statue exclaimed.

The lionfaced figure nodded solemnly and whispered "Eternal be the ruby prison".

cutscene-4-doom-delayed.title: Cutscene 4 - Doom delayed
cutscene-4-doom-delayed.md:
The goblin yanked his wolf mount hard to the left and split off from his outrider group, circling back to the main force. Darting through trees and shrubs the goblin outrider soon came upon the horde, his little dark heart filled with awe as he stood atop a hill and gazed down upon its might. Before the rider and wolf a huge cloud of dust rolled lazily above the canopy of the blackwoods. A myriad of banners all sporting the red hand symbol waved in the air and thousands of goblins marching underneath them. So many tribes all gathered under the red hand, under the warmasters right hand, Warchief Slythe. They would come upon the Bridge upon darkfall, he needed to inform Slythe that the bridge was down, they would need to adjust their route and delay the bloodshed of Teslions.

....

Warchief Slythe face was a vicious frown as his huge monstrous warg Zjar began chewing and crunching, on the ground lay the headless corpse of the goblin outrider. Slythe held a black orb in his right hand and spoke to it, a soft red glow began to pulse in the center of the orb. "Mazterh, ze bridge iz down, we're going the long roudt. Ozy is mizzin, zum adventurez behind it. Tezlionz will still fall"

....

Amidst white and grey clouds the gushing of air flowing by filled the ears of Jawbreaker as he felt a warm sensation from his message pouch. He reached in for the orb and received Warchief Slythe's report. Jawbreaker snarled in anger "Azyrthalunor, help me find Ozyandor, we need to teach her a lesson. We cannot tolerate failure." He turned his gaze down towards the mountains as a huge blue leathery wing swirled up behind him and the air was filled with a mighty earth quaking roar, sparks of electricity showered throughout the air around them. Then Jawbreaker muttered to himself "I underestimated that band of wannabe heroes, lets hope they try to stand their ground in Teslions" turning his frown into a devilish grin.

cutscene-5-old-dogs.title: Cutscene 5 - old dogs
cutscene-5-old-dogs.md:
The old dwarf was going about his business in the Azure market, spices, how he loved his spices. A casual thought in the back of his mind commented how that might have influenced his business, how it might have made him partial to the Fulcrum guild. Mellik took stock and thought it time to head back again, then as he turned Brumor's voice rang in his mind. A magical sending, Red Hand army on the offensive, Dragons. "How many?" he instinctively thought back.

His face set itself in a grim determined look, he straighted his clothes and considered his options. Perhaps it was time to pick up his old trade, retirement had been sweet and brokering deals for adventurous companies had been alot of fun for him. Maybe it was time to see how much of his old network was still alive. He did not quite have the ear of any officials, but he could start by getting the lay of the political landscape. "Who knows, might even have to get ol' Delilah out again." Mellik grined a most vicious and sinister smile, a few people hustling by looked alarmed and a few of those even considered locating a city watch member.

Both of Melliks hands began brushing back his thick set of hair as the cogs of his mind began twirling. He had not bothered much with the ins and outs of the families of Arendur for a long time, a job was a job and you just worked to get the most out of them as you could, people who asked why rarely got a new job. Two busybodies approached him, young pubs fancily dressed like peacocks going to war. The youths was clearly impressed by themselves, most likely fancied they could duel death itself. "Ohoy master dwarf, you've been summoned" one of them addressed him with a hint of arrogance. "Is that so boy?" he replied gruffly. "Dont sulk old man, Faustus wants to see you as soon as you're able, thats all" the youth was apparently not so thick as first impressions would have had Mellik believe. "He can meet me at me office as usual" Mellik replied and began walking away. "But sir, that wont do at all, he needs you to come right away. If you please". Oh well, Mellik thought to himself, Faustus had provided him made jobs over the years and began following along with the two young peacocks. Though, his right hand did seek out and confirm the presence of his hidden dagger.

On his way back from his meeting with Faustus from the Fulcrum guild, Mellik stopped by an old drinking place. He ordered a strong ale and handed the bartender a piece of gold in the shape of a triangle with snipped tips. Soon after a half-orc sat beside him and gruffed an innocent greeting to a stranger and Mellik replied something kin to "atleast its not raining". Mellik had re-opened an old line of communication, hopefully he was not blacklisted.

cutscene-6-darkness-stirs.title: Cutscene 6 - Darkness stirs
cutscene-6-darkness-stirs.md:
Somewhere not on this plane....

His legs stomped the halls of the citadel like a giant, as fast as a lioness, his hands clutched "Slaughter" and "Pain". The taste of blood was still fresh in his mouth from his last kill, elation filled him as "Slaugther" bit deep into the back of another patron of the Slaughtering Citadel. As he began hacking and cleaving separating the head from the body of his kill, the ground around him began to turn into a pool of blood and his feet sank slowly and then in the blink of an eye he fell into the pool and was gone.

She rested her hand against the stone, grateful that even in death she could bring forth silence, otherwise the howling would have broken her mind. Her ancient eladrin eyes could even see in the dark which was good, because most light sources could not survive in the darkness of these tunnels, the howling winds snuffs them out almost immediately. She was not entirely sure where to go or why, but hardly a surprising reward for dying as the willing henchman of a crazed king of bloody slaughter. Her left hand fell down and rested on her trusted old spellbook, she took a break, then the ground beneath her turned soft and a second later she was falling.

He stroked his brow and followed it to the tip of his right horn, enjoying the sights. The random explosions of violence, so beautiful, he had always marvelled at the beauty of the chaotic nature of war. How everyone sort of belonged and came together in a pandemonium of chaos that almost made sense, like everything was meant to be even though that would contradict the chaotic side of things. He shook his head, his mind could not handle such lofty thoughts, he was more down to earth. As he stood, about to jump down from the ledge in the middle of two other patrons and tear them to pieces, he felt gravity pull him down into the stone he was standing on, into a pool of blood.

The Mace with many faces shaped as if laughing manically swiped into his victims face. His own face gleemed with glee, as much as a gnoll could portray this, he was chanting as he smashes his way through victims "From skin to bone, you will beg and moan!". His victims was fleeing, running in fear of his violence "First we slay, then we flay!" he cackled as he began tearing the skin from fallen victims. His devoutness was true and tested, he was a beacon to his people. As he butchered and slaughtered the ground around him turned to more than just spilled blood, it became a deep pool and he fell straight down into it.

Her shield blocked a blow, sword parried a swing, this fight was dragging on. She dropped her shield guard and invited the attack, let it bite deep under her arm and then she clenched down on the weapon with her arm suffering the pain and grinning like a lunatic, she had him! Her iron mask smacked into his face, bone cracked, her faceplate came crashing in one more time SMACK. She wrapped her arm around his weapon hand and brought his arm into an unnatural angle. Then all of a sudden she lost all sense of weight and plummeted into a pool of blood.

In the darkness and the howling wind a voice carried "First we slay, then we flay!" slight monotone rhythm, a drum was beating and odd offkey chimes. "Skin to bone, they will beg and moan!". In the darkness 5 globes of soft blue light shone and slowly rise, carried forth by the will of a god motivated by the voice of a mortal. "Time for slaughter, time for blood!". Below the 5 globes rise the sound of a thousand moans, bones rattle, rusty metal creaks, the stench of death fly on the howling winds.

cutscene-7-marked-for-death.title: Cutscene 7 - Marked for death
cutscene-7-marked-for-death.md:
"No corpses? No souls?!!" a deep voice like boulders cracking against each other "What is the meaning of this Warmaster?!"

"Unfortunately a group of adventurers managed to get the first town to evacuate before our horde descended upon it." The warmasters jaws were clenching ever so fiercely.

"What!? The plan was always to rid the world of those pestering adventurers of the lodge, how are they not dealt with?!"

"Master Stormshadow, we have dealt with all the major adventurers, it is only insignificant ones left. But I have marked them for death, we have kill squads out looking for them, they shall die soon enough." Jawbreaker looked down and tensed, he knew this was a bad start for the campaign.

"Get this dealt with warmaster, now leave me i must continue the ritual, the fane must be maintained. Grail, come, i need your council. Warmaster, i do not want to hear about nosy adventurers no more, understand? Now leave us."

cutscene-8-stormshadow.title: Cutscene 8 - Stormshadow
cutscene-8-stormshadow.md:
# Audience of Stormshadow - Cutscene #8

An 8 foot tall blue scaled dragonborn, clad in rich cloth, walks into a dark cave. A few torches burn with purple light up against the walls, a faint mist rolls around the cave. The distinct sweet smell of rot hangs in the air and faint moans of spirits from the shadowrealm tease the edges of reality here.

The one titled "Warmaster" kneels in a glowing circle filled with mysterious arcane runes, infront of it stands a huge figure mostly hidden in the shadows. "Master Stormshadow, despite minor setbacks, the plan is in motion. We march on Arendur, Ghostlord will soon be ready and Saarvith is overseeing the final stages of the project in Blackspear."

A deep gruff voice rolls against the walls "Good, good. I trust my goblin army suits you well, the gifts of my patron splendidly empowering them. I am preparing for my ritual, the prize for my patron's aid must be paid. My advisor tells me, no doubt much like our goblin spies, that the kingdom of humanity is in a political disarray. Our dragons, giants and goblinkin shall overrun their disorganised attempt at defense." a crunching sound rise from Stormshadow and a small spark of green light illuminates the cave infront of him, where a dark shade of a man hangs in midair. The shade looks humble, yet "Warmaster" gets the feeling that it is a facade, this spirit is anything but humble.

"I trust you can handle the siege of Arendur without me and mine, we do not want to reveal ourselves just yet. Everything must be just right." Stormshadow spreads out his arms wide and filles the air with dust from bones he just crushed and sniffs deeply. "My goblin warlocks will soon begin summoning Meg's monsters and I shall open the gate for her cyclopedian garde in the Fane of misery that "Ripper" has cleared out."

Stormshadow turns around and "Warmaster" lowers his gaze "Meg evil eye, my patron has no real interrest in our struggles, we must not squander her gifts. It is only because i pay the tithe demanded and that means souls. We must harvest as many as possible "Warmaster".

Stormshadow turns around again and begins talking with the shade "Your insights have proven most helpful, i do not think we could have done any of this without you. Soon the pitiful humans will learn who the rightful masters of Diamor is."

Casually Stormshadow says over his shoulder "Warmaster, i almost forgot, i did not summon you here to dote on our masterful plans. I heard we did not harvest many souls in Telions, our first conquest?"

Jawbreakers hand twitched alittle, he had thought this might be why "No, Master, we did not. The town was evacuated before we got there. I am still gathering various information but it seems the same company of adventurers that slain Ratbag, cleared the sunken citadel and broke the Skull Bridge also convinced the town to flee before we got there".

A deep sigh from Stormshadow "We need souls Warmaster, or my patron might decide we are not worth her time and effort. Take care of these heroes" the last words was drawn out with espaperation "I thought we had cleared most of them out already?". Jawbreaker clenched his jaws "We have managed to wipe out several groups of Arendurs lodge members, all but the insignificant ones. These must have slipped under our gaze, I have already issued a kill squad, they are marked for death. And we have eyes in a few towns and in Arendur itself. They shall not disrupt our plans any further."

"Good, i knew there was a reason i entrusted my secret goblin army to a mighty champion of.. HER.. ." Stormshadows voice shifted from soft velvet to cracking of stone "It is a pity i cannot watch Arendur crack, i have little choice the work here must be done."

cutscene-9-smoldering-search.title: Cutscene 9 - smoldering search
cutscene-9-smoldering-search.md:
# Smoldering search - cutscene #9

Teslions, trade town on the edge of Urisa, formerly a bubbling place of merchants travelling in and out of Ursia, now a ghost town. The town still had smoldering ashes from where buildings had been burned down. The smoke was not so oppressive as it probably had been days before. A lone figure was wandering amongst the rubble of the town, turning over various things as if searching for something.

The woman with tar black dreadlocks and bright red eyes, spends many hours amongst the ruins of Teslions, until she walks to the river and stares across it. After standing perfectly still for a minute the woman levitates a foot off the ground and floats across the river as she utters "Qa'tek in pursuit, crystal warrior targeted."

*What is going on, what is happening, whats the point, where is the action?*

Da Cedric spider perlemors puppen rundt om ravne sværdet, eksploderer et blændende lys ud over jer, et smertens skrig udråbt med tusindevis af skovens lyde fylder jeres ører.
Det hele fortager sig og foran jer svæver ravne kongens sværd over jorden, rundt om sværdet på jorden er en stor ritual cirkel fyldt med symboler og sigiler, det ligner sort glasskår og glasstøv der danner cirklen og symbolerne.
Som hvis nogen havde sluppet en pause knap, lyder en hvisken af tusinde stemmer emmer fra sværdet, midt i en messen og så lyder der en dyb subsonisk woooooom og en trykbølge eruptere fra sværdet. Efter et sekund hører i torden i det fjerne og lysglimt rundt omkring i horisonten.

Perlen citadellet omkring begynder at smuldre og bliver til regnbue farvet støv på vinden og svæver væk.

Pippa ligger bevidstløs på jorden i nærheden og et stykke fra jer i en anden retning ligger en anden skikkelse, som rør på sig. Den stønner let og er ved at proppe sig op med den ene arm.

Men så begynder jorden at skælve så småt og iløbet af et par sekunder begynder den decideret at ryste som jordskælv inden den eksploderer ud over jer!

Initiativ! I er ikke surprised

Ormen har store sår og ser ud til at være i forfald, til nærmelsesvis i forrådnelses stadier rundt omkring. En fæl stank omgiver den.

### Recap of Campaign
#### Kl 13:00
- For nyligt hjalp i [The Cautier School](#note/the-cautier-school) med at fange en assassin, en edderkoppe skikkelse. 
- I har Sendt Aurilia og [Antero Calaman](#note/antero-calaman) til HQ for at få organisationen struktureret og besat diverse roller med npc's, sammen med Anton's kærre og Brumor's vogn og en masse af jeres loot.
- Derefter drog i mod en Ranger hytte i det nordlige blackwood, nordvest for Delios for at "grille" ham om hans encounter med Den sorte drage i castle blackspear. 
- På jeres tur, drog ind i Det døde bjerg og fandt at det for tiden lever godt op til sit navn. I nærheden af 60 udøde blev massekreret af både hellig og arkane magi. 
- Men en udød kæmpe skulle vise sig at være Brumor's bane, Cedric skyndte sig at få Brumor væk. Begge forsvandt fra jeres syn et kort øjeblik og kom tilbage igen længere væk fra kæmpen.
- Brumor trak stadig vejret da Cedric kom tilbage med ham. 
- Hvad alle andre end Cedric ikke ved, er at Cedric's sværd hjalp med at teleportere dem væk og hjalp med at skabe en pagt med Asmodeus som gav Brumor livet tilbage. 
- Denne pagt/aftale kostede Cedric et level, han er nu kun lige over level 7.
- Kæmpen blev besejret, men Brumor var mere bleg og afmagten end han nogensinde har været før, han opfordrede til at i tog tilbage til Delios for at han kunne hvile, gerne mindst 4 dage.
- Det er nu 6 timer efter i har forladt Delios 
- og i Befinder i jer nu i det døde bjerg. 

- Aurilia har sendt jer en HQ Rapport, hvor hun beder jer tage stilling til Development points til Organisationen. (Det som vi lige har lavet i bookkeeping). 
- Der er nemlig begyndt at samle sig nok folk om jeres banner ved HQ, til at i kan danne 3 enheder mere. Tier 1. human og dwarf. 

### Strong Start Kl 13:30
*What is going on, what is happening, whats the point, where is the action?*
I nattens mulm og mørke har en lille hær rykket ind for march afstand af Shadow Company HQ, de flyver Charnel house banneret, rød baggrund, oragne circkel med 2 krydsede klinger. 
De har slået lejr og gør klar til kamp.
Vi starter nu en Intrigue, men da linierne allerede er trukket op og hæren står for døren, bliver det kun 2 ture. 
I vælger hvad jeres Organisation gør, selv om i ikke er tilstede. 
I vælger sammen hvilken action der skal tages og vælger en af jer til at rulle evt. tests hvis nødvendigt.
I kan kun bruge jeres proficiency bonus 1 gang, så derfor kan det være en ide at dele tests ud mellem hinanden, men det er ikke noget krav.

	- Muster 1 tier1 enhed mere 
	- Muster jeres special unit Ratcatchers 
	- Muster 2 levies of peasants

	- Saboterer en a fjendes defense? (communications, resolve, resources)

### Start Scene
When last we left our heroes.... Long rest inside tiny hut.

Landskabet er sten og kød, sener, tentakler, tarme, knogler, munde, øjne i alle afskygninger. En morbid afspejlning af den rigtige verden, træer buske, bakker, marker alt sammen i forvrænget kødlig tilstand. Et blegt blåt lys kaster skygger i landskabet, himlen ligner en fjern galakse med gul-grønne skyer og en mørk stjerne himmel. Siden i lagde jer til at sove er der kommet en gul/orange cirkel i himlen og inden i den er der det sorteste sort i nogen sinde har set.

I har fundet et lille område klemt inde mellem nogle "bakker" hvor i har holdt hvil. Da i begiver jer videre ser i flere steder i det fjerne lilla dis der hænger og svæver hen over landskabet. 

Rundt omkring på "jorden" har i også lagt mærke til pytter, med orange væske. logged-strong-start-29.title: Logged strong start 29
logged-strong-start-29.md:
# Option 1
As you are entering the inn's common room, Cedric is talking with the innkeeper about accommodation.

you see ... "table patrons" 

As you finish scanning the room heavy footsteps can be heard on the staircase to the upperfloor and possibly the inn's guest rooms.

Coming down the stairs you see a man in his mid-forties, clad in an almost black full plate adorned with red rims. His chest piece has a red triangle shield with a black leafless tree (dead). 

His hair has gone grey and his face looks weatherbitten and experienced. His light grey eyes seems joyous and his face generally kind. He is adjusting a glove and as he comes halfway down he says loudly "Thank you for your cooperation kind innkeep, these are troubled times we need to pay extra attention to detail." 

As he looks up from his glove and scans the room his eyes fall on your gathered group at the door "Ah, busy evening for the fallen star today". He walks over to the Innkeeper and four soldiers follow him down the stairs all clad in black and red with black scarfs covering most of their faces attached to their helmets. 

He hands the innkeep a coin purse "For your troubles and some furniture" then he looks around the room "Praise our glorious lord regent Baron Hexton" whirls a hand in the air and proceeds towards the door with his soldiers.

He stops at the pc's looks at them with a curious and appriciative look. "Allow me to introduce myself good sir's. I am [Sir Claudio](#note/sir-claudio), Knight of the Black lilly, servant of our Lord Regent, Baron Hexton. Whom do i have the pleasure of greeting? "

"We are searching for miscreants, insidious insurgents, would you believe there are people who oppose the Baron's rule? Those poor misguided fools, everyone knows the Baron is an extension of the King, if they oppose the Baron they oppose the King, the throne of Arendur and the glorious kingdom that is Ursia!" as he finishes the last words he looks around the room and ends with his gaze upon the heroes seemingly observing their reaction to his words.

"Well I shall not detain you further, we got business at the watch keep. Do seek out any of our the Baron's men should you come across any information regarding insurgents. Good night to you"

# Summary Session 38
Main:
Related: [Logged - Session 38](#note/logged-session-38)

# Recap
- I har rejst på tværs af planerne i multiverset og befinder jer udenfor multiverset, et sted som Knogle dronningen kaldte "Rirroneth's domæne i the far realm".
- Anton og Knogle dronningen åbnede en portal hertil via Rirroneth's scepter (obelisken)
- I er taget hertil for at ødelægge stenen i hjertet af perlen og finde Ravne kongens sværd
- I har fundet et andet sværd "Avenger", som ændrer sig til et bestemt våben afhængig af hvem af jer der bruger det. Ifølge knogle dronningen tilhørte sværdet "bittersweet lovers anticipation" en celestial star elf. ikke ravne kongen.
- Perlen ligger ifølge knogle dronningen for enden af den røde vej.
- Knogle dronningen nævnte en Zzharakka, som mulig informations kilde.
- landskabet her ændrer sig hele tiden, det er muligt at et void dragon hjerte kan gøre noget ved dette for jer specifikt.
- Magien er svær at få fat på herude også gudernes tilstedeværelse er fjern
- Riget reagerer på brug af magi.
- Anton forsøgte at reconnescere via nightwing
	- et betændt tårn i et øde landskab der reflektere lys samt en masse 10m store huller i landskabet.
	- i modsat retning var der et stort hvidt område
	- i en anden retning var der et gigantisk orme lignende skikkelse

# Full Summary Session 38
- Sammen med Knogle Dronningen åbnede Anton obelisken mens de andre nakkede chuuls og oozes
- på den anden side af portalen lå ydre riget (far realm), et forvredet sted uden for multiverset.
- Knogle dronningen mente de skulle finde den røde vej for at finde Perlen.
- "Avenger" er ikke Ravne kongens sværd, det tilhører Celestial Elf-True Elf-Star Elf "bittersweet lovers anticipation".
- Det er også "Avenger" der kan ødelægge stenen i hjertet af Perlen.
- De kunne evt finde et void dragon hjerte, hvis de ville prøve at undgå at verdenen hele tiden ændrede sig
- [Zzharakka the overmind from the Rirroneth far realm domain](#note/zzharakka-the-overmind-from-the-rirroneth-far-realm-domain) kan være en informations kilde herude, men han er tricky og snu.
- Der er altid et sært blå-hvidt lys og ingen lyskilde, det er aldrig aften/nat
- Luften er med jævne mellemrum fyldt af stønnen, gnasken, savlen og sukken
- landskabet er en blanding af kød og sten, fyldt med bl.a. øjne i alle størrelse og former
- Nightwing fløj op og Anton kiggede ud over landskabet og så følgende
	- et betændt tårn eller spir, fyldt med huller og åbne sår
		- rundt om spiret var et øde landskab, der reflekterede lyset
		- der var en masse 10m store huller i landskabet
	- I en retning var der et stort hvidt område
- Magien er svær at få fat på i det ydre rige og hvis man mister grebet farer den vild 
	- 7 gibbering mouthers voksede op ad jorden
	- Dele af landskabet begyndte at forme sig om til ord, da man forsøgte at læse dem blev ens sind angrebet
- En sær flok skabninger uden øjne, samlede øjne op og spiste dem. De kaldte sig "illes" og ville gerne have jeres øjne.
	- Brumor kunne ikke holde sig tilbage og startede et slagsmål.
- på jeres færd herude er der blevet fundet

	* spell scroll 3rd devine green decay
